segments.text: Greetings and welcome to the lecture on standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听关于标准操作程序的这一讲。

segments.text: Standard operating procedures represent an administrative control.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序属于一种管理控制。

segments.text: This lecture module has been designed and developed to introduce you to the basic concepts
segments.zh: 本讲模块的设计目的是向大家介绍

segments.text: of design and development of standard operating procedures.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序设计和编制的基本概念。

segments.text: It is intended for beginners.
segments.zh: 它面向初学者。

segments.text: In this lecture module, I will introduce you to the concept of the SOP.
segments.zh: 在本讲模块中，我将向大家介绍标准操作程序的概念。

segments.text: I will introduce you to the process of development of an SOP and provide guidance on the development
segments.zh: 我将介绍标准操作程序的编制过程，并就如何编制

segments.text: of your own specific SOPs.
segments.zh: 你们自己的特定标准操作程序提供指导。

segments.text: Upon completion of this module, you should demonstrate the ability to describe the function
segments.zh: 完成本模块后，你们应能够描述

segments.text: of an SOP, describe the procedure of design, development, implementation and improvement
segments.zh: 标准操作程序的作用，描述标准操作程序的设计、编制、实施和改进

segments.text: of an SOP, and design and develop a basic standard operating procedure.
segments.zh: 过程，并能设计和编制一份基本的标准操作程序。

segments.text: The goal of an SOP is to ensure reproducibility.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序的目标是确保可重复性。

segments.text: What this means is that an SOP ensures that different individuals performing the same
segments.zh: 意思是，标准操作程序确保不同的人执行同一

segments.text: procedure obtain a similar result.
segments.zh: 程序时能得到相似的结果。

segments.text: This is very important in laboratory facilities which are involved in routine diagnostics and
segments.zh: 这对于从事常规诊断和检测的实验室设施

segments.text: testing.
segments.zh: 非常重要。

segments.text: We have a responsibility to the end users as well as to the patients whose samples we
segments.zh: 我们对最终用户以及那些我们正在分析其样本的患者

segments.text: are analyzing and adherence to an SOP ensures that the results are reproducible.
segments.zh: 负有责任，遵守标准操作程序可以确保结果是可重复的。

segments.text: This is a graphical representation of what I have just mentioned.
segments.zh: 这是我刚才所讲内容的图示。

segments.text: In any laboratory facility, we have different individual laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 在任何实验室设施中，都有不同的实验室工作人员个体。

segments.text: Each of them has their own knowledge, skills and abilities.
segments.zh: 他们每个人都有自己的知识、技能和能力。

segments.text: They conduct a same process using an SOP and ideally a good SOP should result in a
segments.zh: 他们使用标准操作程序执行同一个过程，理想情况下，一份好的标准操作程序应当

segments.text: same output for the same result.
segments.zh: 针对同样的结果产生同样的输出。

segments.text: This is what might happen if your SOP has not been developed and designed in accordance
segments.zh: 如果你的标准操作程序没有按照标准程序来编制和设计，

segments.text: with a standard procedure.
segments.zh: 就可能出现这样的情况。

segments.text: You will have different laboratory workers conducting the same process, performing the
segments.zh: 不同的实验室工作人员执行同一个过程，进行

segments.text: same operations and you will have different results.
segments.zh: 同样的操作，却得到不同的结果。

segments.text: In this case, your SOP must be revised and this is part of the performance assessment
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，你的标准操作程序必须修订，这是绩效评估的一部分，

segments.text: which I will discuss in the following week.
segments.zh: 我将在下一周讨论。

segments.text: Now, an SOP is an instructional document.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序是一份指导性文件。

segments.text: It is like a prescription which is reader centered and it is very important to engage
segments.zh: 它就像一份以读者为中心的处方，在编制标准操作程序时，

segments.text: the end users during the development of the SOP.
segments.zh: 让最终用户参与进来非常重要。

segments.text: As a BioRisk Manager, you must obtain input from the end users prior to formulating or
segments.zh: 作为生物风险管理者，在制定或

segments.text: developing the final version of the standard operating procedure.
segments.zh: 编制标准操作程序的最终版本之前，你必须征求最终用户的意见。

segments.text: So the key point is instructional document which implies that it states a clear set
segments.zh: 所以关键点是“指导性文件”，这意味着它给出一套清晰的

segments.text: of instructions which can be achieved, which are measurable and which can be evaluated
segments.zh: 说明，这些说明是可以做到的、可衡量的，并且可以在

segments.text: after completion for performance and other issues.
segments.zh: 完成后就绩效和其他问题进行评价。

segments.text: The instructional document teaches a reader to understand a rule or principle, envision
segments.zh: 指导性文件教读者理解规则或原则、设想

segments.text: a process or workflow, perform a task and use a tool.
segments.zh: 一个过程或工作流程、执行一项任务以及使用一种工具。

segments.text: What this means is that the SOP should be very clear in terms of its context and in
segments.zh: 这意味着标准操作程序在背景方面以及

segments.text: terms of the step-by-step implementation.
segments.zh: 逐步实施方面都应该非常清晰。

segments.text: The word envision refers to the ability of an individual to visualize the process.
segments.zh: “设想”这个词指的是个人在脑海中呈现这个过程的能力。

segments.text: So the process must be comprehensible to the reader or to the laboratory worker as
segments.zh: 所以这个过程必须让读者或者实验室工作人员，视情况而定，

segments.text: the case may be.
segments.zh: 能够理解。

segments.text: They should be able to apply the step-by-step procedure to perform the task or to use a
segments.zh: 他们应该能够运用这个逐步程序来执行任务或使用

segments.text: tool as in the case of a laboratory, this may be a specific piece of equipment.
segments.zh: 工具，在实验室中，这可能是某台特定的设备。

segments.text: Let us now move on to the process of development of an SOP.
segments.zh: 现在我们来讲标准操作程序的编制过程。

segments.text: The process of development of an SOP depends on the process of analysis.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序的编制过程取决于分析过程。

segments.text: So we first analyze a specific procedure, we design a set of steps around that particular
segments.zh: 我们首先分析一个特定的程序，围绕这个特定

segments.text: procedure, we develop these steps and translate them into a document, we implement these steps
segments.zh: 程序设计一套步骤，编制这些步骤并把它们转化为文件，在实验室层面

segments.text: at the laboratory level and we evaluate the procedure for effectiveness and consistency
segments.zh: 实施这些步骤，并评价该程序的有效性和操作的

segments.text: of operation.
segments.zh: 一致性。

segments.text: This is the basic procedure for SOP development.
segments.zh: 这是编制标准操作程序的基本流程。

segments.text: Now an instructional document or an SOP is based on certain other prerequisites.
segments.zh: 指导性文件或标准操作程序是以某些其他前提为基础的。

segments.text: An SOP is generally based on a policy which is a plan or guiding principle that influences
segments.zh: 标准操作程序一般基于方针，方针是一种影响

segments.text: other action.
segments.zh: 其他行动的计划或指导原则。

segments.text: So this is the parent of the SOP which is the policy.
segments.zh: 所以方针就是标准操作程序的上位文件。

segments.text: The policy then gets translated into a program plan which is a set of tasks or actions
segments.zh: 然后方针被转化为计划方案，计划方案是一套按照特定顺序或方式

segments.text: performed in a specified sequence or manner that achieves a particular result.
segments.zh: 执行、以达到特定结果的任务或行动。

segments.text: And finally, the program plan is translated into a procedure.
segments.zh: 最后，计划方案被转化为程序。

segments.text: A procedure is a specific task, work or instruction or action and procedures may include actions
segments.zh: 程序是一项具体的任务、工作或指令或行动，程序可以包括行动

segments.text: as well as other specific requirements.
segments.zh: 以及其他具体要求。

segments.text: A policy document is written with a certain audience in mind, we always ask who the
segments.zh: 方针文件在编写时心中有特定的读者，我们总是会问

segments.text: audience is, who is the end user of the SOP or the policy document, who writes the
segments.zh: 读者是谁，标准操作程序或方针文件的最终用户是谁，谁来编写

segments.text: document, the authors of the document.
segments.zh: 文件，也就是文件的作者是谁。

segments.text: This may be the biarisk manager as well as certain experts in that field and the intended
segments.zh: 这可能是生物风险管理者以及该领域的某些专家，还有标准操作程序的

segments.text: purpose of the SOP.
segments.zh: 预期用途。

segments.text: SOP has a very specific purpose and this must be clearly defined in the scope and objectives
segments.zh: 标准操作程序有非常具体的用途，这必须在标准操作程序的范围和目标中

segments.text: of the SOP.
segments.zh: 明确界定。

segments.text: For instance, we will be looking at the process of disposal of biological waste in compliance
segments.zh: 例如，我们将考察如何处置生物废物，使之符合

segments.text: with national regulations for the purpose of this particular lecture module.
segments.zh: 国家法规，这是本讲模块所用的例子。

segments.text: So I have answered those questions.
segments.zh: 我已经回答了这些问题。

segments.text: So in the case of this particular document, who writes this document?
segments.zh: 那么就这份文件而言，谁来编写这份文件？

segments.text: It's the biarisk manager in consultation with the laboratory workers and management.
segments.zh: 是生物风险管理者在与实验室工作人员和管理层协商后编写。

segments.text: Who is the audience?
segments.zh: 读者是谁？

segments.text: Laboratory workers and external contractors.
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员和外部承包商。

segments.text: Now I have used this specific term external contractor because in most containment laboratories,
segments.zh: 我用了“外部承包商”这个特定术语，是因为在大多数防护实验室中，

segments.text: the process of disposal of biological waste or chemical waste is done via a third party
segments.zh: 生物废物或化学废物的处置过程是由第三方

segments.text: or an external contractor.
segments.zh: 或外部承包商完成的。

segments.text: And this external contractor must be fully cognizant with regard to the SOP.
segments.zh: 而这个外部承包商必须充分了解标准操作程序。

segments.text: And what is the intended purpose of the SOP is basically to ensure the safe disposal of
segments.zh: 标准操作程序的预期用途是什么呢？基本上就是确保按照国家法规

segments.text: biological waste in compliance with national regulations.
segments.zh: 安全处置生物废物。

segments.text: This comes down to our original intent or our original title.
segments.zh: 这又回到了我们最初的意图或最初的标题。

segments.text: Now in order to develop your SOP, you must visualize the process.
segments.zh: 为了编制你的标准操作程序，你必须在脑海中呈现这个过程。

segments.text: You should envision the entire process.
segments.zh: 你应该设想整个过程。

segments.text: Now this is a process is envisioned very simplistically.
segments.zh: 这里对这个过程的设想非常简化。

segments.text: So we have biological waste, which is being produced by a facility on a daily basis.
segments.zh: 我们有生物废物，设施每天都在产生这些废物。

segments.text: And this biological waste must be segregated at the facility itself in order to ensure
segments.zh: 这些生物废物必须在设施内就进行分类，以确保

segments.text: that it is disposed of safely.
segments.zh: 它们得到安全处置。

segments.text: So we can dispose of the waste after segregation as radioactive waste, biological waste or
segments.zh: 分类之后，我们可以视情况把废物作为放射性废物、生物废物或

segments.text: chemical waste as the case may be.
segments.zh: 化学废物进行处置。

segments.text: Now in order for the transporter or the contractor to identify this particular waste, the laboratory
segments.zh: 为了让运输方或承包商能够识别这些废物，实验室

segments.text: workers must ensure that the waste is labeled appropriately, following which the waste is
segments.zh: 工作人员必须确保废物贴上了适当的标签，之后废物被

segments.text: transported to another facility for disposal and incineration as the case may be.
segments.zh: 运送到另一个设施进行处置，并视情况进行焚烧。

segments.text: Now most of the biological waste within a containment facility is autoclaved and incinerated.
segments.zh: 防护设施内的大部分生物废物都要经过高压灭菌和焚烧。

segments.text: Autoclaving must be conducted or carried out at the facility itself.
segments.zh: 高压灭菌必须在设施本身内进行。

segments.text: And incineration may have to be carried out at another facility, as this involves specific
segments.zh: 而焚烧可能必须在另一个设施进行，因为这需要特定的

segments.text: equipment such as incinerators.
segments.zh: 设备，比如焚烧炉。

segments.text: Radioactive waste and other waste such as chemical waste, which may be components of the biological
segments.zh: 放射性废物以及其他废物，比如可能属于生物废物组成部分的

segments.text: waste must also be treated in compliance with national regulations and guidelines.
segments.zh: 化学废物，也必须按照国家法规和指南进行处理。

segments.text: So this is basically our program plan for our SOP development.
segments.zh: 这基本上就是我们编制标准操作程序的计划方案。

segments.text: So the program plan designates specific steps.
segments.zh: 计划方案规定了具体的步骤。

segments.text: So we have the procedure for collection of waste, procedure for segregation of waste,
segments.zh: 我们有废物收集程序、废物分类程序、

segments.text: transport of waste, decontamination and neutralization of waste, procedure for labels and signage,
segments.zh: 废物运输、废物去污和中和、标签和标志程序、

segments.text: procedure for training of personnel handling biological waste and the personnel protective
segments.zh: 生物废物处理人员的培训程序，以及管理生物废物时

segments.text: equipment which must be worn when managing biological waste.
segments.zh: 必须穿戴的个人防护装备。

segments.text: Now all of these represent separate SOPs in the program plan for the disposal of
segments.zh: 所有这些在生物废物处置的计划方案中

segments.text: biological waste.
segments.zh: 都是独立的标准操作程序。

segments.text: The sections of the SOP are as follows.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序包括以下几个部分。

segments.text: An SOP has conditions, context, specific actions and documentation.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序有条件、背景、具体行动和文件记录。

segments.text: Let us look at these sections one by one.
segments.zh: 让我们逐一看看这些部分。

segments.text: The conditions for the SOP should answer these following questions.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序的条件应当回答以下问题。

segments.text: Who should use the SOP?
segments.zh: 谁应该使用这份标准操作程序？

segments.text: When should it be used?
segments.zh: 什么时候使用？

segments.text: Why should it be used?
segments.zh: 为什么要使用？

segments.text: And where should it be used?
segments.zh: 在哪里使用？

segments.text: An SOP is a very specific document.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序是一份非常具体的文件。

segments.text: It cannot be adapted for use to other situations or if it is adapted, it should undergo the
segments.zh: 它不能改作他用，如果要改作他用，就必须经过

segments.text: process of implementation and validation.
segments.zh: 实施和验证的过程。

segments.text: This is why these specific questions must be established when we set up the conditions
segments.zh: 这就是为什么在为编制标准操作程序设定条件时

segments.text: for the development of the SOP.
segments.zh: 必须明确这些具体问题。

segments.text: In this case of disposal of laboratory waste, the users of the SOP are the laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 在处置实验室废物这个例子中，标准操作程序的使用者是实验室工作人员。

segments.text: It is used during the disposal of laboratory waste.
segments.zh: 它在处置实验室废物时使用。

segments.text: It is used for the safe disposal of biological waste and it should be used at the containment
segments.zh: 它用于安全处置生物废物，应当在防护

segments.text: facility, transport and disposal facility as defined by the respective SOPs.
segments.zh: 设施、运输和处置设施中使用，具体由相应的标准操作程序规定。

segments.text: The next aspect of SOP writing involves establishment of context.
segments.zh: 编写标准操作程序的下一个方面是确立背景。

segments.text: So the context involves a basic process in which we have an input.
segments.zh: 背景涉及一个基本过程，其中有一个输入。

segments.text: In this case, we have biological waste as an input.
segments.zh: 在这个例子中，输入是生物废物。

segments.text: The actions which are used to treat that biological waste or mitigate the risk of exposure
segments.zh: 然后是用来处理这些生物废物，或降低实验室人员

segments.text: of laboratory personnel and the external environment to that biological waste.
segments.zh: 和外部环境接触这些生物废物风险的行动。

segments.text: So we have specific actions which are listed in the SOP and the output which is the intended
segments.zh: 所以标准操作程序中列出了具体的行动，还有输出，也就是

segments.text: outcome of that particular SOP.
segments.zh: 这份标准操作程序的预期结果。

segments.text: When you establish context for an SOP, please ensure that you include preparation.
segments.zh: 在为标准操作程序确立背景时，请务必包括准备工作。

segments.text: Preparation assumes readiness before implementation of the SOP.
segments.zh: 准备工作假定在实施标准操作程序之前已经做好了准备。

segments.text: For instance, what this implies is that specific procedures must be in place prior
segments.zh: 例如，这意味着在实施废物处置标准操作程序之前，

segments.text: to the implementation of the SOP for the disposal of waste.
segments.zh: 必须已经落实了具体程序。

segments.text: This may include training of the laboratory personnel with regard to the segregation of
segments.zh: 这可能包括就把废物分为生物、化学和其他组分

segments.text: the waste into biological, chemical and other components.
segments.zh: 对实验室人员进行培训。

segments.text: Now we are developing this SOP based on the following context.
segments.zh: 我们基于以下背景来编制这份标准操作程序。

segments.text: We develop the SOP assuming that personnel are trained, that they are competent, that
segments.zh: 我们编制标准操作程序时假定人员经过了培训、具备胜任能力、

segments.text: facilities for storage are available, facilities for segregation exist, facilities for transportation
segments.zh: 有可用的储存设施、有分类设施、有运输设施，

segments.text: exist and facilities for decontamination exist.
segments.zh: 并且有去污设施。

segments.text: This is an assumption.
segments.zh: 这是一种假设。

segments.text: Now if any of these following measures do not exist, we must develop an SOP to fill
segments.zh: 如果以下任何一项措施不存在，我们就必须编制一份标准操作程序

segments.text: in the gap.
segments.zh: 来填补空缺。

segments.text: The actions are specific steps which must be taken to move from the input to the
segments.zh: 行动是从输入到输出必须采取的

segments.text: output.
segments.zh: 具体步骤。

segments.text: As I mentioned earlier, an SOP is reader-centric, so the steps should be very clearly stated
segments.zh: 正如我前面提到的，标准操作程序以读者为中心，所以步骤应当表述得非常清楚，

segments.text: and should not be ambiguous.
segments.zh: 不能含糊不清。

segments.text: These are some of the steps or the actions which must be incorporated in the SOP for
segments.zh: 这些是废物处置标准操作程序中必须纳入的一些步骤或行动，

segments.text: waste disposal and I have stated here checklist.
segments.zh: 我在这里写了“检查单”。

segments.text: Now an SOP can be translated into a checklist with a step and a check mark.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序可以转化为由步骤和勾选标记组成的检查单。

segments.text: So the steps as follows, place all the waste from the facility into the designated container.
segments.zh: 步骤如下：把设施中的所有废物放入指定容器。

segments.text: So I check, label the containers with the designated labels, check and transfer the
segments.zh: 我打勾，用指定标签标记容器，打勾，然后把

segments.text: containers to the staging areas checked and inform the shipper when 50% of the staging
segments.zh: 容器转移到暂存区，打勾，当暂存区被占用50%时

segments.text: area has been occupied, checked and so on and so forth.
segments.zh: 通知承运人，打勾，依此类推。

segments.text: So these actions can be clearly defined and once the action has been completed, the
segments.zh: 这些行动都可以明确界定，一旦行动完成，

segments.text: BiRisk Manager can check the SOP for implementation.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理者就可以检查标准操作程序的执行情况。

segments.text: In addition to the SOP itself and the checklist, documentation must be incorporated into the
segments.zh: 除了标准操作程序本身和检查单之外，还必须把文件记录纳入

segments.text: SOP and included in the appendices.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序，并放在附录中。

segments.text: This documentation includes cross-references such as guidelines and best practices, regulatory
segments.zh: 这些文件记录包括交叉引用，比如指南和最佳实践、有关

segments.text: documentation pertaining to national laws on disposal of biological waste, as well as
segments.zh: 生物废物处置的国家法律的监管文件，以及

segments.text: specific regional regulations.
segments.zh: 具体的地区性法规。

segments.text: An SOP must be implemented and this provides a testing bed for the SOP.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序必须付诸实施，这为标准操作程序提供了一个检验平台。

segments.text: The SOP is tested at the level of the laboratory workbench and these are some of the questions
segments.zh: 标准操作程序在实验室工作台层面进行检验，以下是

segments.text: which a BiRisk Manager must pose to the end users of the SOP.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理者必须向标准操作程序最终用户提出的一些问题。

segments.text: The first one concerns comprehension.
segments.zh: 第一个问题涉及理解。

segments.text: We must ask our end users if they understand the SOP.
segments.zh: 我们必须询问最终用户是否理解这份标准操作程序。

segments.text: In some cases, the language used in the SOP may be too technical or too complicated for
segments.zh: 在某些情况下，标准操作程序中使用的语言可能过于专业或过于复杂，

segments.text: an end user to comprehend and comprehension is critical in order to minimize errors.
segments.zh: 最终用户难以理解，而理解对于尽量减少差错至关重要。

segments.text: An SOP should not be ambiguous.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序不应含糊不清。

segments.text: The next aspect involves implementation.
segments.zh: 下一个方面涉及实施。

segments.text: We must inquire with the end user if they could physically do what the SOP asks, if
segments.zh: 我们必须询问最终用户，他们实际上能否做到标准操作程序要求的事情，如果

segments.text: no, why.
segments.zh: 不能，原因是什么。

segments.text: For instance, if you have provided a laboratory worker with a biosafety suit which is not
segments.zh: 例如，如果你给实验室工作人员提供的生物安全防护服

segments.text: of the appropriate size, he or she may not be able to wear it or if they do wear it,
segments.zh: 尺码不合适，他或她可能穿不上，或者即使穿上了，

segments.text: they may not be able to perform the operation because the suit is too tight.
segments.zh: 也可能因为防护服太紧而无法进行操作。

segments.text: So in this case, an observation will provide the BiRisk Manager with the appropriate input.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，通过观察可以为生物风险管理者提供适当的信息。

segments.text: The next aspect is reproducibility.
segments.zh: 下一个方面是可重复性。

segments.text: This comes back to different laboratory users achieving the same outcome and if no, why
segments.zh: 这又回到不同的实验室使用者能否取得相同的结果，如果不能，原因是什么。

segments.text: The next aspect is consistency.
segments.zh: 下一个方面是一致性。

segments.text: And this is critical when we do diagnostic testing in the laboratory as errorless results
segments.zh: 这在实验室进行诊断检测时至关重要，因为错误的结果

segments.text: can lead to different diagnosis and can affect the stakeholders and end users.
segments.zh: 可能导致不同的诊断，并可能影响利益相关方和最终用户。

segments.text: So all of these aspects must be documented during the process of implementation of an SOP.
segments.zh: 所以在标准操作程序实施过程中，所有这些方面都必须记录下来。

segments.text: Another aspect of SOP development involves validation and in validation we have what
segments.zh: 标准操作程序编制的另一个方面是验证，在验证中，我们有一种

segments.text: is known as behavioral observation data.
segments.zh: 叫作行为观察数据的东西。

segments.text: A behavioral observation data is basically a questionnaire which we provide to the laboratory
segments.zh: 行为观察数据基本上是一份问卷，我们把它发给实验室

segments.text: worker or the end user and all that he or she has to do is answer it as a yes or a
segments.zh: 工作人员或最终用户，他或她只需要回答“是”或

segments.text: no.
There is no ambiguous answer for a DoD questionnaire.
segments.zh: BOD问卷没有模棱两可的答案。

segments.text: For example, does X don his biosafety suit in compliance with the SOP?
segments.zh: 例如，X是否按照标准操作程序穿上了他的生物安全防护服？

segments.text: Yes or no?
segments.zh: 是还是否？

segments.text: For example, if the answer is no, then we investigate Y.
segments.zh: 例如，如果答案是否，我们就调查Y。

segments.text: If the answer is yes, we continue with that particular SOP.
segments.zh: 如果答案是是，我们就继续执行这份标准操作程序。

segments.text: So these are very useful in validating the SOPs from the perspective of the end user.
segments.zh: 所以从最终用户的角度来看，这些对验证标准操作程序非常有用。

segments.text: So DoDs help us to check and validate SOP.
segments.zh: 所以BOD帮助我们检查和验证标准操作程序。

segments.text: They are an objective assessment as an observer basically observes the laboratory worker and
segments.zh: 它们是一种客观评估，因为观察者基本上是在观察实验室工作人员并

segments.text: collects data.
segments.zh: 收集数据。

segments.text: The observer himself improves as the observer notes the discrepancies between the SOP statements
segments.zh: 观察者自身也会进步，因为观察者会注意到标准操作程序条文

segments.text: as well as the implementation plan.
segments.zh: 与实施计划之间的差异。

segments.text: And finally, the DoD allows us to communicate across the group.
segments.zh: 最后，BOD让我们能够在整个团队中进行沟通。

segments.text: For instance, if a specific laboratory worker cannot achieve a specific objective and obtain
segments.zh: 例如，如果某位实验室工作人员无法达到特定目标，得不到

segments.text: the reproducible result, it may be an indication of the failure of the system.
segments.zh: 可重复的结果，这可能表明体系出了问题。

segments.text: And this can be addressed by communicating across the organization.
segments.zh: 这可以通过在整个组织内沟通来解决。

segments.text: So DoD data must involve personnel who will be observed and developing the DoD questionnaire.
segments.zh: 所以BOD数据必须让被观察的人员参与进来，并参与编制BOD问卷。

segments.text: For instance, if I am the biorisk manager and laboratory worker is involved in a specific
segments.zh: 例如，如果我是生物风险管理者，而某位实验室工作人员参与某项特定

segments.text: procedure, I will involve him or her during the process of development of the questionnaire
segments.zh: 操作，我会让他或她参与问卷的编制过程，

segments.text: as they are more aware of certain factors which the biorisk manager may not be able
segments.zh: 因为他们更了解某些生物风险管理者可能无法

segments.text: to observe.
segments.zh: 观察到的因素。

segments.text: The ability also ensures consistency and it provides an opportunity for self-audit which
segments.zh: BOD还能确保一致性，并提供自我审核的机会，这种自我审核

segments.text: is more realistic than an audit done by a third party.
segments.zh: 比第三方进行的审核更贴近实际。

segments.text: Now SOPs in general must be approved.
segments.zh: 一般来说，标准操作程序必须经过批准。

segments.text: And this procedure of approval may involve several rounds of discussion and we may have
segments.zh: 这个批准程序可能涉及几轮讨论，我们可能会

segments.text: consultative sessions with the biorisk managers, even the top management and the case stakeholders.
segments.zh: 与生物风险管理者、甚至最高管理层和关键利益相关方进行协商。

segments.text: So once an SOP has been designed and developed, it is tested in the lab, implemented and finally
segments.zh: 所以一份标准操作程序设计编制完成后，要在实验室进行检验、实施，最后

segments.text: an approval is obtained which legalizes the SOP at the level of the organization.
segments.zh: 获得批准，从而在组织层面使这份标准操作程序正式生效。

segments.text: SOPs are living documents, they have to be revised and reviewed constantly and the review
segments.zh: 标准操作程序是动态文件，必须不断修订和评审，评审

segments.text: is dependent on various factors such as near miss, accidents or incidents.
segments.zh: 取决于各种因素，比如险兆事件、事故或事件。

segments.text: If you experience accidents or incidents in your laboratory when implementing a specific
segments.zh: 如果你们在实验室实施某份标准操作程序时发生了事故或事件，

segments.text: SOP, the SOP will have to be reviewed.
segments.zh: 就必须对该标准操作程序进行评审。

segments.text: You may also have to review an SOP when the results are inconsistent.
segments.zh: 当结果不一致时，你可能也需要评审标准操作程序。

segments.text: This SOP must be revised and reviewed periodically.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序必须定期修订和评审。

segments.text: So prior to review of an SOP, we must check the documentation and determine whether there
segments.zh: 所以在评审标准操作程序之前，我们必须检查文件记录，确定是否

segments.text: has been any sign that it has been previously reviewed or revised.
segments.zh: 有迹象表明它以前被评审或修订过。

segments.text: If there are too many revisions, it may be indicative of the failure in certain steps
segments.zh: 如果修订次数太多，可能表明标准操作程序的某些步骤

segments.text: of the SOP.
segments.zh: 存在问题。

segments.text: And a review must be undertaken in consultation with the end users.
segments.zh: 评审必须与最终用户协商进行。

segments.text: Before you review or revise the document, you must obtain the pertinent documentation
segments.zh: 在评审或修订文件之前，你必须获取以日志或实验室档案形式

segments.text: in the form of logs or laboratory files.
segments.zh: 存在的相关文件记录。

segments.text: There may be obstacles when you try to implement a revision.
segments.zh: 当你试图实施修订时，可能会遇到障碍。

segments.text: This may be because of a lack of equipment at the facility or a lack of ability to communicate
segments.zh: 这可能是因为设施缺乏设备，或者无法在实验室使用者之间

segments.text: the SOP across the laboratory users.
segments.zh: 传达标准操作程序。

segments.text: And there are some solutions which may be implemented routinely for reviewing and revising
segments.zh: 有一些解决办法可以在评审和修订标准操作程序时

segments.text: SOPs.
segments.zh: 常规采用。

segments.text: We now move on to the general format of the SOP or the standard operating procedure.
segments.zh: 现在我们来讲标准操作程序的一般格式。

segments.text: This is the general format of the SOP.
segments.zh: 这是标准操作程序的一般格式。

segments.text: I have not gone into specifics of SOPs as you will be developing a range of SOPs based
segments.zh: 我没有深入讲解标准操作程序的具体内容，因为你们将根据

segments.text: on your specific organization requirements.
segments.zh: 自己组织的具体要求编制一系列标准操作程序。

segments.text: These are some of the components.
segments.zh: 这些是其中的一些组成部分。

segments.text: So an SOP always commences with the title page.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序总是以标题页开头。

segments.text: The title page may include the specific logos of your organization as well as a note indicating
segments.zh: 标题页可以包括你们组织的特定标志，以及一条说明，

segments.text: that it is a controlled document and the revision number.
segments.zh: 表明它是受控文件，还有修订号。

segments.text: SOPs which are more than three pages long must be appended with a table of contents.
segments.zh: 超过三页的标准操作程序必须附上目录。

segments.text: Examples of specific words or terms which may not be comprehensible to the end user
segments.zh: 对最终用户来说可能难以理解的特定词语或术语，其释义

segments.text: must be included in the SOP.
segments.zh: 必须包含在标准操作程序中。

segments.text: The purpose of an SOP must be stated from a regulatory context.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序的目的必须从监管背景的角度加以说明。

segments.text: For instance, SOP for the donning and doffing of personal protective equipment must clearly
segments.zh: 例如，个人防护装备穿脱的标准操作程序必须清楚地

segments.text: state that this SOP has been designed and developed for laboratory workers who wish or
segments.zh: 说明，这份标准操作程序是为希望或

segments.text: intend to don and doff personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 打算穿脱个人防护装备的实验室工作人员设计编制的。

segments.text: The procedures in an SOP must be clearly stated in a step-by-step format.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序中的程序必须以逐步的格式清楚地表述。

segments.text: The health and safety warnings must be included in SOP.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序中必须包括健康和安全警示。

segments.text: For instance, usage of a specific chemical agent for sterilization may pose certain
segments.zh: 例如，使用某种特定化学试剂进行灭菌可能会给

segments.text: health and safety risks to laboratory workers.
segments.zh: 实验室工作人员带来某些健康和安全风险。

segments.text: This must be stated in the SOP.
segments.zh: 这必须在标准操作程序中说明。

segments.text: We must also include what are known as cautions because sometimes SOPs are used concurrently
segments.zh: 我们还必须包括所谓的注意事项，因为有时标准操作程序会与

segments.text: with other SOPs and this can cause interferences.
segments.zh: 其他标准操作程序同时使用，这可能会造成相互干扰。

segments.text: So this must be stated in the SOP.
segments.zh: 所以这必须在标准操作程序中说明。

segments.text: For instance, a laboratory SOP for spill cleanup may involve the use of chemicals.
segments.zh: 例如，实验室溢洒清理的标准操作程序可能涉及使用化学品。

segments.text: And this chemicals may be hazardous to human health and may also compromise the engineering
segments.zh: 这些化学品可能对人体健康有害，还可能因腐蚀而损害工程

segments.text: systems by corrosion.
segments.zh: 系统。

segments.text: So in this case, we must state the interferences over the concurrent SOPs which must be read
segments.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我们必须说明与同时使用的标准操作程序之间的干扰，这些标准操作程序必须

segments.text: together with the SOP in general.
segments.zh: 与本标准操作程序一并阅读。

segments.text: Quality assurance and quality control are within the scope of the QC and QA policy of the
segments.zh: 质量保证和质量控制属于组织的QC和QA方针的范围，

segments.text: organization and the SOP must take this into account as well as take into account
segments.zh: 标准操作程序必须考虑到这一点，并在实施过程中考虑

segments.text: other regulatory requirements during its implementation.
segments.zh: 其他监管要求。

segments.text: The SOP must also include the references, the contact lists indicating the authors and
segments.zh: 标准操作程序还必须包括参考文献、注明作者和

segments.text: the bi-risk managers.
segments.zh: 生物风险管理者的联系人名单。

segments.text: The related SOPs must be included in the appendices.
segments.zh: 相关的标准操作程序必须列在附录中。

segments.text: The distribution concerns the number of copies which are made because the SOP administrator
segments.zh: 分发涉及复印的份数，因为由标准操作程序管理员

segments.text: decides who will obtain the copy and the location at which the SOP will be available.
segments.zh: 决定谁可以获得副本，以及在什么地点可以获取标准操作程序。

segments.text: Archiving must be mentioned in the SOP as well as archiving ensures that the SOP is
segments.zh: 标准操作程序中还必须提到存档，因为存档可以确保标准操作程序

segments.text: available for audit.
segments.zh: 可供审核。

segments.text: As a general practice, all versions of the SOP including revisions and comments must be
segments.zh: 作为一般做法，标准操作程序的所有版本，包括修订和意见，都必须

segments.text: maintained in the archive in order to ensure that the process of auditing an SOP is carried
segments.zh: 保存在档案中，以确保标准操作程序的审核过程能够

segments.text: out smoothly.
segments.zh: 顺利进行。

segments.text: The key messages which I wanted to get across to you in this module are as follows.
segments.zh: 我想在本模块中传达给大家的要点如下。

segments.text: SOPs are instructional documents which ensure reproducibility.
segments.zh: 标准操作程序是确保可重复性的指导性文件。

segments.text: They are designed to achieve a single outcome.
segments.zh: 它们是为实现单一结果而设计的。

segments.text: Ideally, one specific outcome should have one specific SOP.
segments.zh: 理想情况下，一个特定的结果应当对应一份特定的标准操作程序。

segments.text: For instance, the donning of a mask should be governed by one SOP, a single SOP itself.
segments.zh: 例如，戴口罩应当由一份标准操作程序，也就是单独一份标准操作程序来规范。

segments.text: The donning of a complete set of personal protective equipment will be governed by another SOP.
segments.zh: 穿戴全套个人防护装备则由另一份标准操作程序来规范。

segments.text: Effective SOP writing takes key components into account.
segments.zh: 有效的标准操作程序编写要考虑关键组成部分。

segments.text: When we develop an SOP, we must take into account the inputs from the respective stakeholders
segments.zh: 在编制标准操作程序时，我们必须考虑相关利益相关方的意见，

segments.text: and validation and evaluation of the SOP is critical to the process of continuous quality
segments.zh: 而标准操作程序的验证和评价对持续质量

segments.text: improvement.
segments.zh: 改进过程至关重要。

segments.text: That brings us to the end of this module on standard operating procedures which are a very
segments.zh: 关于标准操作程序的本模块到此结束，标准操作程序是一种非常

segments.text: important administrative control.
segments.zh: 重要的管理控制。

segments.text: Thank you very much for watching this video lecture and I wish you a pleasant learning
segments.zh: 非常感谢大家观看本视频讲座，祝大家学习

segments.text: experience.
segments.zh: 愉快。

segments.text: Thank you.
segments.zh: 谢谢。
